dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, have you heard from the university in Toronto yet?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, hæv juː ˈhɜːrd frəm ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ ˈjɛt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not yet. They'll email me on Friday. I wish it were Friday today!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt. ðeɪl ˈiːmeɪl miː ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ. aɪ ˈwɪʃ ɪt wɜːr ˈfraɪdeɪ təˈdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I hope they accept you. You'd love Toronto.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ðeɪ əkˈsɛpt juː. juːd ˈlʌv təˈrɑːntoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too, but I'm not very hopeful. They only choose five students.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː, bʌt aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈvɛri ˈhoʊpfəl. ðeɪ ˈoʊnli ˈtʃuːz ˈfaɪv ˈstuːdənts.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Don't be so pessimistic! Your grades are great.
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt bi ˈsoʊ ˌpɛsəˈmɪstɪk! jʊr ˈɡreɪdz ər ˈɡreɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm not pessimistic. I'm just being realistic.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈnɑːt ˌpɛsəˈmɪstɪk. aɪm ˈdʒʌst ˈbiːɪŋ ˌriːəˈlɪstɪk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Well, I'm optimistic. I think your dream will come true.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, aɪm ˌɑːptəˈmɪstɪk. aɪ ˈθɪŋk jʊr ˈdriːm wɪl ˈkʌm ˈtruː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I hope so. If I go, you can come and visit me in Toronto!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈsoʊ. ɪf aɪ ˈɡoʊ, juː kən ˈkʌm ənd ˈvɪzɪt miː ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed. And I hope your flight home goes well.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɪŋɡərz ˈkrɔːst. ənd aɪ ˈhoʊp jʊr ˈflaɪt ˈhoʊm ˈɡoʊz ˈwɛl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks. I just wish I didn't have to say goodbye.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. aɪ ˈdʒʌst ˈwɪʃ aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈhæf tə ˈseɪ ɡʊdˈbaɪ.
